lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments are visible on the left lateral torso. Spacing is tighter on the posterior half and becomes increasingly wider toward the shoulder region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is present on the third line from the posterior, splitting in the upper third of the torso toward the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The four most anterior line segments are abbreviated, terminating mid-flank and failing to connect with the ventral fringe line.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density grouping of approximately 4-5 white spots is visible on the upper posterior haunch near the tail insertion point.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate, spiral trajectory. From the skull base, the vectors extend laterally and posteriorly before curving medially and anteriorly toward the terminal tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal tips is approximately 1.8 times the combined pixel width of the two horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Ivory-colored terminal tipping accounts for approximately 22% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white transverse chevron between the medial canthi of the eyes and a distinct white patch on the lower throat/upper chest boundary.
